title: New York enacts the RAISE Act with 72-hour safety incident reporting
summary: Governor Kathy Hochul signed the Responsible AI Safety and Education (RAISE) Act on 19 December 2025, making New York the second state to require frontier AI developers to publish protocols for managing catastrophic risks and to report critical safety incidents, including death or bodily injury caused by unauthorized modification or exfiltration of model weights or loss of control, to a new office in the Department of Financial Services within 72 hours. Civil penalties reach $1 million for a first violation and $3 million per subsequent violation, the law takes effect on 1 January 2027, and the governor secured commitments to chapter amendments aligning it with California's Transparency in Frontier AI Act.
